name: supervision
description: We write your reusable computer vision tools. 💜
one_liner: A toolbox of ready-made building blocks for computer vision projects, counting objects in video, drawing boxes around detected items, tracking things across frames, so you don't code that from scratch.
buyer: A computer-vision engineer at a retail or security company building a custom video-analytics product who doesn't want to reinvent basic detection and tracking plumbing.
business_use_cases: A retail analytics startup quickly builds a 'count customers per hour' or 'track shelf stock' product for small stores from off-the-shelf camera feeds.
A parking-lot operator builds a low-cost license-plate and vehicle counting system instead of buying an expensive proprietary one.
A freelance CV developer builds bespoke video-analytics dashboards for warehouses, farms, and construction sites using it as the core toolkit.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a specific vertical video-analytics product (e.g. a retail footfall counter) using it as the engine
Offer custom computer-vision development services for small businesses that can't afford enterprise CV vendors

steal_this: This weekend, wire it to a cheap webcam and build one narrow, sellable demo, like a 'how many cars pass this driveway' counter, and pitch it to one local business.
